skillFull: Transforms into a crow at given intervals, taking to the skies. Fly around the tower, and steal jewels as you get close to them. Stealing a jewel creates Jewel Shard Jellies, granting you points. Successfully steal all 3 jewels to receive bonus points based on the number of Stolen Jewels collected, as well as create Crowfeather Jellies relative to the number of Stolen Jewels. When the skill finishes, the Cookie rides a broomstick and Blasts for a certain period of time. Level up for more points for Jewel Shard Jellies, more points per stolen jewel, as well as points for Crowfeather Jellies. (If you get too close to a window getting cleaned by a Cookie, you drop all Stolen Jewels.)
story: If you ever happen upon a crow aimlessly wandering close by a jewel-filled treasure chest you're about to open, watch out! It might just be the shapeshifting Crowberry Cookie, looking for the next jewel to snatch! This Cookie is decorated with so many sparkling crowberries that actual crows mistake it for a piece of jewelry! Crowberry Cookie flies around in the air, only coming down to grab the next gleaming keepsake. If you take your eyes off the feathery pointed hat for a second, this Cookie is covered by large, black wings, only to be gone the next instant. All the stolen ornaments end up fancily decorating a far-away tower; however, the Cookie claims to just put them in fitting places. Even after such an unbelievable statement, you can't seem to help to nod in agreement after seeing the Cookie's friendly smile! Can you be sure you haven't been put under a spell?
